messages:
omar: Quick alert  ACME replayed a missed-hour export overlapping our ingestion window. We're seeing negative deltas for a few accounts. Who can triage?

katie: Can we get sample payloads? Suspect they changed event_ids on retry so our dedupe missed them.

acme-ing-engineer: Sorry all  we retried with new uuids after a 429 storm. Sample: ```json
{"customer_id":"acct-900","usage_units":750,"timestamp":"2026-06-01T01:00:00Z","event_id":"evt-new-777"}
```

claire: From reconcile: matches entitlement fingerprint but different event_id. 9 accounts negative net so far.

sam: Support has one customer impacted; need a short note and ETA.

omar: Proposed actions: create exception for Billing Ops, require X-Partner-Replay header on replays (reject otherwise), and update partner runbook. @billing-ops-bot please create ticket.

billing-ops-bot: EX-2026-803 created and assigned to @claire. SLA 48h.

claire: I'll take EX-2026-803. Please send CSV mapping replay->original ids. I'll run dry reconcile and then apply reversals as needed.

acme-ing-engineer: CSV sent and we've halted the backfill. We'll add X-Partner-Replay header and preserve event_ids on retries.

katie: I'll add the ingest guard to reject missing header and create an alert for replay spikes. Patch ETA 3h.

sam: Drafting customer-facing blurb. Will post to #support-drafts after Claire posts numbers.

claire: Dry-run shows 9 accounts affected, total over-credit ~6,700 units. Applying manual reversals and attaching audit ids to EX-2026-803. Keeping ticket open 48h for verification.

omar: Thanks team. Schedule a 30m sync with ACME PM to agree on replay tools and tests. Closing loop for now. :thumbsup:
